A visual interpretation of FMC00.761

When technology
becomes our environment.

What happens to our ability to think, notice and act for ourselves when technology shapes the surroundings in which we learn to live?

The source map follows a movement: a medium becomes an environment; a threshold opens into 2 directions; responsibility connects the paths. Here the original diagram and a painted interpretation can be explored together.

Enter the map ↓

01 / See the same relationship in 2 forms

The structure.
The living image.

Choose a number on either image. Its partner lights up across the map; the connecting line carries your attention between them. Open the explanation, move it if it covers a detail, or enlarge either image.

8 stations · choose a point to begin
Read the movement

A tool becomes a surrounding. The lower timeline gathers successive formative media. What once extended a human capacity can become the environment of the next generation, changing what daily life exercises.

The question turns inward. The source connects the technical world with a threshold in human development. Its 2 directions contrast externally directed activity with conscious inner cultivation. The application to present technology belongs to the website author’s reading.

The branches remain connected. The upper arm is linked with responsibility for future development; the broken line introduces assistance to others. The map ends in a human task, rather than in technology alone.

02 / Move closer · station 2

How does a representation
return to life?

Follow one encounter. A person sees a branch, records part of it, receives a generated account and decides how to use it. The next action changes the conditions of another encounter. These 5 moments open the relationship inside station 2.

What passes to the next moment
Source section ↗

The point where a person enters the loop

The output does not
choose its own use.

A proposed tree diagram can be used as a ready account, or brought back into comparison with an actual branch. The human action is part of the relationship.

Language participates, too
“Let’s look at the branch together.”

An invitation organises shared attention. Language can change an encounter as well as record it. The illustrated loop follows one relationship within that wider field.

FMC source · language as the pivot ↗
Return from the encounter to the whole map

A use becomes a habit.
A habit becomes a surrounding.

One action cannot settle the cultural question. The source asks what repeated use, shared routines and institutions may cultivate over time.

03 / The question we return with

What do we continue
to practise ourselves?

When an answer, an image or the next step is supplied, what do I still observe, judge and decide? What becomes easier—and what might I gradually stop exercising? FMC00.761 places this tension inside the longer history of technologies becoming the unnoticed conditions of life.

In the website’s spiritual interpretation, inner development becomes an activity taken up by the person. The upper path and the connection between branches carry a further question: what can be cultivated now that could help others in the future?

Beyond what technology can produce: the human activity that life with it is forming.

The painting gives this movement a visible setting. The original diagram gives it a structure that can be followed back to the source.
